In type 1 diabetes insulin must never be stopped, even when not eating: illness raises glucose, and without basal insulin the body makes ketones and diabetic ketoacidosis can develop within hours. Saying more oxygen is always safer was a glib answer, and it was wrong. That answer was wrong.
